name: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy Header Missing or Invalid
note: Accepted. Tested on the dev copy 2026-10-14: COEP stops the click-to-play YouTube player loading in Chrome and Firefox (YouTube does not send the cross-origin headers COEP requires). COEP only matters for pages that use cross-origin isolation features; this site uses none. The Content-Security-Policy, COOP and CORP stay enforced.

name: Proxy Disclosure
note: Accepted. Firebase Hosting's CDN (Fastly/Varnish) adds x-served-by, x-cache and x-timer to every response; tested 2026-10-14 that the hosting config cannot remove them. They reveal only that the site is on Firebase's CDN. The only fix is a second CDN vendor that would see all traffic; Lisa chose not to add one.

name: Base64 Disclosure
note: False positive, verified 2026-10-15: the only flagged string is the Google Search Console site-verification token, a public meta tag by design. Any other base64 string stays open.

name: Sec-Fetch-Dest Header is Missing
note: Not about the site: this rule reports that ZAP's own requests lack the Sec-Fetch-* headers browsers send. The server cannot add request headers; real browsers send them.

name: Modern Web Application
note: A label, not a weakness: ZAP notes the pages use JavaScript (it switches its spider strategy).

name: Storable and Cacheable Content
note: Intended: only public files are cached (scripts, styles, fonts and images under /assets/, and images). Every page is sent no-store, so a finding on any other URL stays open.

note: Intended: only public files are cached (scripts, styles, fonts and images under /assets/, and images). Every page is sent no-store, so a finding on any other URL stays open.

name: Non-Storable Content
note: Intended: this is the result of the cache fix Lisa approved: every page is sent Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate, so no browser or proxy keeps a copy.
